question: Odacchi, Odacchi!!! All I can see in the waves on p. 154 of Volume 70 is bunnies!!! What have you done to me?!!! Y, Law-Loving A’s Friend
answer: Geez, what a long pen name! I’d like to tell you a story from Papua New Guinea. It is that when the rabbits ran out of food to eat, they tricked the fish into lining up so they could cross the sea on the backs of the fish. Do you supposed they made up that folk tale when they noticed the dancing white waves looked like rabbits? They do look like that sometimes, don’t they?
name: Law-Loving Y
